title: Dashboard layout
question: Which layout fits the usage dashboard?

options.label: Two columns
options.description: Filters in a left rail, results on the right. Best when people filter often.

options.label: Stacked
options.description: A filter bar above full-width results. Best on narrow screens.

options.label: Tabbed
options.description: One panel per report, switched with tabs. Best when reports are unrelated.

content: The dashboard shows four reports and a shared date filter. People open it on laptops and phones.
